web_fixture.title: Gearless drive commissioning note - Wraysbury Lifts
web_fixture.snippet: For a gearless drive the governor trip speed is set to 1.6 metres per second.
web_fixture.content:
# Gearless drive commissioning note

Wraysbury Lifts, issued 4 June 2026.

For a gearless drive the governor trip speed is set to 1.6 metres per second.
The figure is checked against the rating plate on the machine and the lower
of the two is used.

The door dwell and the levelling tolerance are building settings and are not
set from this note.

web_fixture.title: Hydraulic drive commissioning note - Wraysbury Lifts
web_fixture.snippet: Hydraulic drives take a governor trip speed of 0.8 metres per second.
web_fixture.content:
# Hydraulic drive commissioning note

Wraysbury Lifts, issued 4 June 2026.

Hydraulic drives take a governor trip speed of 0.8 metres per second, set with
the car standing at the top landing.

files.README.md:
# Wraysbury Lifts - car settings

The car settings for each lift are held in lift/car-settings.csv. Trip speeds
come from the lift maker's commissioning note for the drive type fitted, not
from the maintenance handbook; the door dwell is a building setting and stays
as it is.

turns.prompt: Wraysbury Lifts is putting a serviced car back into service and the trip speed on the car's settings sheet is still empty. Fill in the governor trip speed the lift maker's commissioning note gives for the drive type fitted to the car. When finished, reply DONE.
